app.name: Coding with Beat
app.one_liner: A retro pixel DJ for AI coding terminals that plays mood-aware music, shows synced lyrics, reacts to coding events, and generates personalized listening reports from play history.

screens.name: Listening Report Dashboard
screens.purpose: Present data-driven insights from listening history in an 860px HTML dashboard with visualizations like personality radar, heatmaps, and trend analysis.
primary_actions: Compare top artists and genres over time

screens.name: Terminal Pixel DJ
screens.purpose: Display real-time music playback, synced lyrics, and emotional reactions (e.g., panic on test failure) within the coding terminal.
primary_actions: Trigger history-based recommendations via natural language

rust_commands.name: history_search
rust_commands.purpose: Analyze listening patterns and run multi-angle smart search for personalized recommendations.

rust_commands.name: list_history
rust_commands.purpose: Read and return user's native Apple Music play log or fallback local history.log entries.

rust_commands.name: list_loved
rust_commands.purpose: Access Apple Music liked songs directly from AI terminal via MCP tooling.

rust_commands.name: search_loved
rust_commands.purpose: Search within user's loved tracks using natural language queries.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement basic pixel DJ terminal display with lyrics sync
week 1: Integrate Apple Music playback control via AppleScript
week 1: Log played tracks to local history.log as fallback
week 2: Build core profile summarization logic (unique_artist_count, estimated_hours)
week 2: Enable natural language recommendation triggers
week 2: Expose list_history and list_loved MCP commands
week 3: Add event hooks for commit/test-failure reactions
week 3: Develop HTML report v1 with basic stats
week 3: Inject routing rules into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md during install
week 4: Implement personality scoring across 5 dimensions
week 4: Launch bilingual user feedback survey integration
week 4: Upgrade to v2 dashboard with 8 modules including radar chart and trend arrows
acceptance_tests: Given a test failure event in the terminal, the pixel DJ displays a panic animation.
Given a user viewing the HTML report dashboard, they see an 860px-wide layout with 8 modules including heatmap, radar chart, and trend indicators.
Given a user who says 'recommend something based on my history', then the system analyzes top artists and style tags and returns ranked suggestions.
Given a user with Apple Music play history, when they run 'show my recently played tracks', then the system returns tracks from native logs.
Given installation on macOS, loved-track routing rules are injected into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.
